events.title: Hoare publishes CSP
events.summary: Tony Hoare published Communicating Sequential Processes in August 1978 — a model for concurrent programs communicating through channels.
events.about: CSP influenced [Go]'s goroutines, occam, and formal reasoning about concurrency. Hoare's earlier Hoare logic (1969) and CSP together shaped how programmers verify and structure parallel systems.

narrative.whyChosen: CSP gave a foundational model for message-passing concurrency.
narrative.whyImportant: It influenced language design and verification for parallel and distributed systems.
narrative.problemSolved: Shared-memory concurrency was error-prone without structured communication primitives.
